title: ERIN’S KING
html_source:
Erin’s King is apparently the name of a boat Bloom remembers being on with Milly. However, Erin is another name for Ireland. Who is Ireland’s king?
Erin is a Hiberno-English derivative of the Irish word “Éirinn”. “Éirinn” is the dative case of the Irish word for Ireland.
